'''Vulptillas''' were [[Fox (creature)/Legends|fox]]-like [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures that developed crystalline [[Armor/Legends|armor]] around their vital areas, as they reached maturity, and possessing great intelligence. They were apex predators of the frozen wastes.<ref name="TORWeb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181219|text=#SWTOR Cartel Market Newest Additions: Week of December 18}}</ref> The '''Infernal''' variants were found underground in areas with molten activity, with their fiery eyes and glowing crystalline armor. Around [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.10.1}}</ref> they were very desirable to beast tamers across the galaxy and could be used as mounts.<ref name="TOR" />
